lightoverlay.config.title: Light Overlay
lightoverlay.config.enabled.description: Whether the light level overlay is shown. Can also be toggled with a key binding.
lightoverlay.config.show_while_holding_t: Also show the overlay while a torch is held in either hand, even when it is toggled off.
lightoverlay.config.display_mode.descrip:
How each block is marked. All indicators are colored by spawn risk.

Night number: the block light level, which is the light level at night.
Day and night numbers: the night light level, plus the light level during the day in small.
Cross: a colored cross.
Square: a small colored square.
lightoverlay.config.hide_safe.descriptio: Only show blocks where hostile mobs can spawn (block light 0).
lightoverlay.config.skirts_enabled.descr: For floors above your eyes, whose top you can't see, draw a colored skirt fading upwards along their open edges. Makes unlit ledges and overhangs easy to spot.
lightoverlay.config.skirt_height.descrip: How high the skirts reach, in blocks.
lightoverlay.config.horizontal_radius.de: How many blocks around the player are scanned horizontally.
lightoverlay.config.vertical_radius.desc: How many blocks above and below the player are scanned.
lightoverlay.config.update_interval.desc: How often the light levels around the player are rescanned. 20 ticks = 1 second.
lightoverlay.config.safe_color.descripti: Block light above 0: hostile mobs cannot spawn here.
lightoverlay.config.warning_color.descri: Block light 0 under open sky: hostile mobs spawn here at night.
lightoverlay.config.danger_color.descrip: Block light 0 and dark sky: hostile mobs can spawn here at any time.
lightoverlay.config.torch_helper_mode.de:
Shows where to place torches while the overlay is visible. The next torch is marked by a ghost torch with a pulsing beam.

Off: no suggestions.
Smart: simulates the light of a torch on every floor block in range, including the real walls and floors, and plans torches that light up all dark floor, starting where you stand. Planned spots stay put while you move, and the next torch is the one that lights the dark floor closest to you.
Grid: a fixed placement pattern, see the Grid options. The closest grid spot that still lights up dark floor is the next torch.
lightoverlay.config.min_light_level.desc: Light level a block needs to count as lit. 1 is enough to stop hostile mobs from spawning since 1.18; raise it if you want brighter areas. The torch's light level is taken from the light source in your hand (a torch if you hold none).
lightoverlay.config.show_coverage_previe: Tint the dark floor that the next torch would light up.
lightoverlay.config.indicator_color.desc: Color of the suggested torch spots, the beam and the coverage preview.
lightoverlay.config.suggestion_count.des: How many torch spots are shown at once. The plan covers all dark floor in range; these are the spots that light the dark floor closest to you, the first one is the next torch.
lightoverlay.config.look_ahead.descripti: How many blocks beyond the scan radius are taken into account. Torches are still only suggested within the scan radius, but they also light up dark floor beyond it, so a spot near the edge can be the better choice. The planner covers at most 24 blocks around you, plus the look-ahead.
lightoverlay.config.grid_pattern.descrip:
How the grid spots are laid out. The spacing follows from the torch's light level and the minimum light level, so on flat ground every block ends up lit.

Diamond: a tilted lattice whose light diamonds fit together without overlap, the fewest torches possible.
Staggered rows: rows of torches, every other row shifted by half a gap. Nearly as efficient and easier to follow.
Square: a plain square grid, about twice as many torches.
lightoverlay.config.grid_anchor.descript:
What the grid lines up with. Use the Pin Torch Grid key (G by default, can be bound to a mouse button) to pin the grid to the block you look at instead; press it again on the same spot to unpin.

World: the world origin, so the grid is the same everywhere.
Nearest torch: the torch closest to you.
Newest torch: the torch placed last, so the grid re-aligns whenever you place a torch off the grid.
lightoverlay.config.grid_margin.descript: Moves the grid spots closer together by this many blocks, to leave some slack for uneven ground.
